autoresume.state.self: Claude Code will continue by itself at {time}
autoresume.state.noReset: The usage limit's reset time is unknown, so this chat won't be resumed automatically
autoresume.note.copy: If the chat is still open (for example in the Claude Code panel), Claude Code continues a copy in the background and leaves the original chat unchanged.
autoresume.note.claudeOnly: Auto-resume works with Claude Code chats only.
autoresume.note.how: After an API error, or once a usage limit resets, Agent Monitor runs “claude --bg --resume” with the resume prompt.
autoresume.unavailable.cliNotFound: Claude Code's command-line tool wasn't found
autoresume.unavailable.cliTooOld: This Claude Code version can't continue chats in the background. Update Claude Code.
autoresume.unavailable.noCwd: The chat's folder no longer exists
autoresume.error.cliNotFound: Claude Code's command-line tool wasn't found
autoresume.error.cliTooOld: this Claude Code version can't continue chats in the background
autoresume.error.noCwd: the chat's folder no longer exists
autoresume.error.untrusted: Claude Code doesn't trust this folder yet (run claude in it once and accept the trust prompt)
autoresume.error.exit: Claude Code exited with an error
autoresume.error.timeout: Claude Code didn't respond within 60 seconds
autoresume.error.notResumable: this chat can't be continued right now
autoresume.toast.copied: {project}: the chat was still open, so Claude Code continues a copy in the background. The original chat is unchanged.
autoresume.toast.stale: That auto-resume already ran or changed, so nothing was done.
autoresume.terminal.sent: The command is typed in the terminal: press Enter, accept Claude Code's trust prompt, then type /exit. After that, Continue in background works in this folder.
autoresume.push.line.scheduled: Auto-resume is on for this project: continuing at {time} (attempt {n} of {max}).
autoresume.push.line.self: Auto-resume is on for this project: Claude Code will continue by itself at {time}.
autoresume.push.line.noReset: Auto-resume is on, but the usage limit's reset time is unknown, so it won't continue by itself.
autoresume.push.line.gaveUp: Auto-resume is on, but it has already tried {max} times.
autoresume.push.body.copied: {project}: the chat was still open, so a copy continues in the background (attempt {n} of {max}).
autoresume.push.body.gaveUp: {project}: stopped again after {max} attempts, so it won't be resumed any more.
autoresume.pick.title: Auto-resume: choose projects
autoresume.pick.placeholder: Checked projects continue by themselves after an API error or when a usage limit resets
autoresume.pick.savedNone: Auto-resume is off for every project.
autoresume.skip.off: auto-resume was turned off for this project
autoresume.skip.late: the stop is more than 24 hours old
